headline: Australian Housing Market Softens as Prices Fall in Major Capitals
summary: Australian property prices are undergoing an historic downturn across most regions, with Darwin remaining the sole capital city still experiencing house-price gains while researchers project the trend could soon turn.
why: Residential property is the largest asset class in Australia. Declining home values affect consumer wealth effects, mortgage underwriting, and retail spending.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Slumping house prices weigh on property valuations and residential transaction fees.
